name: dev-pack
description: 개발 워크플로 패키지. 기능 개발·버그 수정·리팩터링·코드베이스 탐색 절차 스킬과 커밋(commit)·README 작성(readme-writer) 스킬을 제공하고, 외부 플러그인(feature-dev, context7, security-guidance, serena, playwright, claude-md-management)을 함께 설치한다. Ships feature-development, bug-fix, refactoring, codebase-exploration, commit, and readme-writer skills, and bundles the feature-dev, context7, security-guidance, serena, playwright, and claude-md-management plugins.
